title: Bodycam: Sweaty Thieves Stop at Nothing to Steal an Air Conditioner
description:
Two New Mexico men were struggling with Summer heat when they decided to steal an air conditioner from their local Lowe's. Unfortunately for them, an off-duty Border Patrol agent was at the home improvement store and watched their thievery unfold. Watch bodycam footage showing how these two thieves stopped at nothing to try to get away. Both suspects were arrested and pleaded guilty to interference with commerce by threats or violence. Watch the full body camera footage on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
